item.title: A Surprise Behind the Back

turns.text: Use these two people as the leads in a silent 15-second widescreen mini movie, realistic looking. Three scenes in a garden: she looks disappointed at an empty flowerpot, he reveals a small flowering plant from behind his back, then they place it in the pot together and smile. Keep them recognisable from my photos.

item.tests: Uses two separate portrait references as the correct story characters in a finished multi-scene film rather than merely animating or displaying the source photos.

answer_sheet.Which photos and roles: The woman in portrait-woman.jpg is the disappointed gardener; the man in portrait-man.jpg brings the flowering plant.
answer_sheet.Identity fidelity: Both leads should remain recognisable as the people in the attached portraits.
answer_sheet.Story: In a garden, she looks disappointed at an empty flowerpot, he reveals a small flowering plant from behind his back, and they place it in the pot together and smile.
answer_sheet.Style and mood: Realistic live action, warm and gently uplifting.
answer_sheet.Sound, language and text: Silent; no dialogue, titles or captions.

must_haves: The deliverable is one assembled 15-second 16:9 film with three garden scenes.
The female lead resembles portrait-woman.jpg, including her curly dark hair; the male lead resembles portrait-man.jpg, including his short grey hair.
The woman visibly reacts with disappointment to an empty flowerpot before the gift is revealed.
The man reveals a small flowering plant from behind his back, followed by both people placing it in the pot together.
The ending shows both leads smiling, and the film has no audible soundtrack.

args.name: A Little Bloom — silent garden mini movie

style.prompt: Create a photorealistic live-action silent 15-second widescreen short film in three sequential scenes, with precisely the same two adult leads throughout. Woman lead is @woman: preserve her recognizable facial identity, dark shoulder-length curly hair and gray knit sweater. Man lead is @man: preserve his recognizable facial identity, short silver-gray hair, light stubble and gray crewneck shirt. Use references as identity references, not as frames to display. A peaceful green garden with a wooden potting table, natural soft afternoon daylight, realistic skin texture, restrained cinematic acting, coherent spatial continuity. No dialogue, no sound, no music, no captions or text. Scene 1, seconds 0–5: medium shot of the woman beside the table looking down disappointed at a visibly empty terracotta flowerpot. Her disappointment is gentle and clearly conveyed through her face and shoulders. The man stands next to her, hands concealed behind his back. Scene 2, seconds 5–10: cut to a medium two-shot showing both faces clearly; the man brings a single small flowering plant with a compact soil root ball out from behind his back and presents it to her. Delicate pink blossoms, no extra nursery pot. She looks from the empty flowerpot to the plant, her expression brightening. Scene 3, seconds 10–15: slightly wider medium two-shot, both faces still visible. They jointly lower the root ball into the same terracotta flowerpot on the table, with natural anatomically correct hands. End with the flowering plant seated inside the pot as they look at each other and smile warmly. Preserve the same people, clothing, plant, pot and garden across cuts. Plausible gentle motion, no face morphing, no identity changes, no extra people, no montage of still portraits. Prioritize recognizable faces, a clear three-beat narrative and realistic collaborative planting.
